description: This file contains the implementation of network model queries related to WAN interfaces, including creation, cleanup, and monitoring of interface statuses using netmodel queries and callbacks. It manages state synchronization, flag setting, and autosensing adjustments for WAN interface status changes.

classes.name: nm_query_ll_info_t
classes.description: Structure holding information related to network model queries for logical links, including query handles and interface details.

classes.name: intf_isup_queries_t
classes.description: Structure holding the status of interface up queries for IPv4 and IPv6, along with related query object handles.

methods.name: void ll_queries_clean(nm_query_ll_info_t ** info)
methods.description: Cleans up and frees memory associated with nm_query_ll_info_t structure and closes related queries.

methods.name: void nm_query_response_phys_up_cb(UNUSED const char * sig_name,const amxc_var_t * data,void * priv)
methods.description: Callback invoked upon physical interface up/down status change, notifying autosensing if the reference is not used internally.

methods.name: void nm_query_create_phys_up_query(nm_query_ll_info_t * info)
methods.description: Creates a query to monitor the physical interface's up/down status.

methods.name: void nm_query_response_ll_cb(UNUSED const char * sig_name,const amxc_var_t * data,void * priv)
methods.description: Handles response for lower layer query, updating the stored lower layer information.

methods.name: void nm_query_create_ll_query(const char * intf_path,nm_query_ll_info_t * info)
methods.description: Creates a query to determine the lower layer of a given interface.

methods.name: void nm_query_response_name_cb(UNUSED const char * sig_name,const amxc_var_t * data,void * priv)
methods.description: Handles name query response, updating interface name and upstream interface path, and initiating further queries.

methods.name: bool wan_mode_up(amxd_object_t * wan_mode_obj)
methods.description: Checks whether all interfaces in a WAN mode are active/up, returning true if all are up.

methods.name: void nm_query_mode_active_handle_flags(const amxc_var_t * data,amxd_object_t * intf_obj,const char * flag,ipversion_t ip_version)
methods.description: Handles setting or clearing netmodel flags based on interface activation state, and manages autosensing accordingly.

methods.name: void nm_query_mode_active_cb(UNUSED const char * sig_name,const amxc_var_t * data,void * priv)
methods.description: Callback for IPv4 mode interface activation, managing flags and autosensing.

methods.name: void nm_query_mode6_active_cb(UNUSED const char * sig_name,const amxc_var_t * data,void * priv)
methods.description: Callback for IPv6 mode interface activation, managing flags and autosensing.

methods.name: int nm_query_create_name_query(amxd_object_t * wan_mode,nm_query_ll_info_t * info,const char * flag)
methods.description: Creates a query to resolve interface names based on the WAN mode and flags.

methods.name: int nm_query_ll_add(amxd_object_t * wan_mode)
methods.description: Adds/improves network model logical link queries for a specified WAN mode, managing query handles and state.

methods.name: void intf_isup_queries_clean(intf_isup_queries_t ** nm_queries)
methods.description: Cleans up and frees memory for interface up/down queries.

methods.name: void init_intf_isup_query(amxd_object_t * interface,intf_isup_queries_t * nm_queries,ipversion_t ip_version)
methods.description: Initializes parameters and determines if an interface up query should be created for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: int open_intf_isup_query(amxd_object_t * interface,netmodel_callback_t handler,ipversion_t ip_version)
methods.description: Opens an interface up/down query for IPv4 or IPv6 and assigns the callback handler.

methods.name: int nm_query_mode_active(void)
methods.description: Creates and starts monitoring network mode activity, including per-interface checks.

methods.name: void nm_close_sensing_queries(void)
methods.description: Stops all monitoring queries for current WAN modes and cleans up interface flags.
